_readme: Round 4 of popular-title Gutenberg batch. Nils excluded per no-children's-books policy. Buddenbrooks/Steppenwolf/Oedipus at Colonus/Human All Too Human all real-text verified.

books.title: Uncle Silas
books.author: Sheridan Le Fanu
books.synopsis: Orphaned heiress Maud Ruthyn is placed under the guardianship of her charming, sinister uncle Silas, whose remote house hides a decades-old murder and a fresh plot against her life.

books.title: Wylder's Hand
books.author: Sheridan Le Fanu
books.synopsis: A bridegroom vanishes on the eve of his wedding to an heiress, and as his cousin Captain Stanley Lake circles the family fortune, an old house's buried secrets and a hidden corpse surface.

books.title: The Beetle
books.author: Richard Marsh
books.synopsis: A shapeshifting Egyptian cult-priestess stalks a rising London politician to avenge a past outrage, terrorizing a tramp, a scientist, and a young woman engaged to her target in a novel that outsold Dracula on release.

books.title: The Willows
books.author: Algernon Blackwood
books.synopsis: Two canoeists camping on a flooded Danube island sense unseen, ancient presences pressing in from the willow thickets around them, until their camp itself seems to conspire against their escape.

books.title: The White People
books.author: Arthur Machen
books.synopsis: A young girl's secret diary records her initiation by her nurse into a hidden, ancient system of sorcery and forbidden rites in the Welsh hills, framed by a recluse's essay on true evil.

books.title: The Call of Cthulhu
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.synopsis: A scholar assembles his late uncle's notes on a monstrous cult worshipping the sunken god Cthulhu, tracing dreams, a sailor's testimony, and a South Pacific island that should not exist.

books.title: At the Mountains of Madness
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.synopsis: An Antarctic expedition uncovers the frozen ruins of a pre-human civilization beyond impossible peaks, and the survivors' account warns the world never to go back.

books.title: The Dunwich Horror
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.synopsis: A monstrous, half-human child born to a decayed New England family grows into something that outstrips barns and shatters houses, until scholars from Miskatonic University attempt to banish it.

books.title: The Shadow over Innsmouth
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.synopsis: A young traveler's detour through a decaying Massachusetts fishing town reveals its inhabitants' inherited, amphibious secret, and a night of pursuit through its empty streets he barely survives.

books.title: The Colour Out of Space
books.author: H. P. Lovecraft
books.synopsis: A meteorite crashes onto a New England farm and leaches an indescribable color into the soil, water, and family living there, withering them from within before the land is abandoned as a blasted heath.

books.title: The Pit
books.author: Frank Norris
books.synopsis: A Chicago wheat speculator's ruthless corner on the grain market enriches and then consumes him, while his wife Laura drifts toward an artist even as her husband's empire collapses around them.

books.title: Ramona
books.author: Helen Hunt Jackson
books.synopsis: A half-Native orphan raised in a proud Californio family falls for a Luiseño sheep-shearer, and their marriage draws them into the violent dispossession of Native land by incoming American settlers.

books.title: Pan
books.author: Knut Hamsun
books.synopsis: A hunter living alone in a northern Norwegian forest is consumed by a volatile, self-destroying passion for a local merchant's daughter, told in fragments recalled two years after the fact.

books.title: Buddenbrooks
books.author: Thomas Mann
books.synopsis: Four generations of a wealthy Lübeck merchant family decline from civic grandeur into illness, failed marriages, and irrelevance, as commercial ambition gives way to art, illness, and doubt.

books.title: Steppenwolf
books.author: Hermann Hesse
books.synopsis: A solitary, suicidal intellectual who thinks of himself as half man, half wolf is drawn out of his isolation by a dance-hall woman into jazz clubs, drugs, and a hallucinatory Magic Theater confronting his fractured self.

books.title: Oedipus at Colonus
books.author: Sophocles
books.synopsis: The blind, exiled Oedipus reaches a sacred grove near Athens with his daughter Antigone, where Theseus grants him sanctuary as Creon and his own son fight over his prophesied burial place.

books.title: Human, All Too Human
books.author: Friedrich Nietzsche
books.synopsis: Nietzsche breaks from Wagner and Schopenhauer to dissect morality, religion, and art as products of human psychology rather than eternal truths, in aphorisms addressed to 'free spirits.'

mentions.mentioned: The Narrative of Arthur Gordon Pym
mentions.author: Edgar Allan Poe
